title: Professional Certificate Course in Marketing Communication Strategy and Planning
description: Participants will learn how to develop and implement effective marketing communication strategies that align with business objectives and generate measurable results.
longDescription: Understand and apply the concept of Market Segmentation. Develop a Marketing Communications Plan. Understand the Marketing Communications Planning Framework. Understand the concept of Positioning and Repositioning. Understand the nature and application of Marketing Communication Theories. The course Marketing Communication Strategy and Planning aims to provide participants with a comprehensive understanding of marketing communication principles and best practices. By the end of the course, participants should be able to develop and implement effective marketing communication strategies that align with business objectives, target the right audience, convey compelling messages, and generate measurable results.
